assumptions.signal_availability: Feature session close plus vendor delivery. Actual historical vendor delay is unverified, so no observation is marked execution-ready.
assumptions.entry: Earliest considered entry is the next exchange-session close strictly before the earliest verified disclosure bound. This is a timing proxy, not a fill.
assumptions.option_selection: Candidate contracts must satisfy the fixed research quote screen recorded in the reviewed-cohort manifest. Multipliers, deliverables, and adjusted contracts remain unverified; midpoint fills are not assumed.
assumptions.cost_model: When usable bid/ask quotes exist, buy at ask and sell at bid. Absent a usable quote, the trade is non-executable rather than filled at last trade or midpoint.
assumptions.holding_period: Hold until the earlier of the verified disclosure reaction session or the close of the tenth subsequent exchange session after the feature date. No intraday exit is claimed.
assumptions.position_sizing: Unit notional per episode for diagnostics only. Capital limits and simultaneous position caps are unspecified until population evaluation is authorized.
exclusions: No fill when vendor delivery timing is unverified.
No fill when quote eligibility or contract multiplier is unverified.
No fill when disclosure chronology remains unresolved.
No short premium strategies in this protocol version.
